BBox.description:
Normalized bounding box in [x0, y0, x1, y1] corners format.

All coordinates are normalized to [0.0, 1.0] relative to page dimensions.
Uses corners format (ScholarDoc convention) with a to_xywh() helper for
CryptOfCogito compatibility.
BBox.title: BBox

BibEntry.description:
A bibliography/references list entry.

v2.0.0: Uses BibliographicRecord for full bibliography fields instead of
ParsedCitation which is designed for in-text citation parsing.
BibEntry.title: BibEntry

BibliographicRecord.description:
Full bibliography entry data for BibEntry.

Provides richer bibliographic fields than ParsedCitation, which is designed
for in-text citation parsing. BibliographicRecord captures complete reference
list entries with all standard bibliographic metadata.

work_abbreviation.description: Standard abbreviation (e.g., 'SZ' for Sein und Zeit, 'KrV' for Kritik der reinen Vernunft)
work_abbreviation.title: Work Abbreviation

BibliographicRecord.title: BibliographicRecord

Citation.description:
An in-text citation reference.

v2.0.0: Decomposes the old CitationType into two dimensions:
- citation_format: How it appears in text (parenthetical, numeric, etc.)
- reference_system: What coordinates locate the passage (Stephanus, Bekker, etc.)

raw_text.description: Citation text as it appears in source
raw_text.title: Raw Text

citation_format.description: How the citation appears in text (e.g., parenthetical, numeric)

reference_system.description: What coordinates locate the referenced passage (e.g., Stephanus, Bekker)

bib_entry_id.description: Link to bibliography entry element ID
bib_entry_id.title: Bib Entry Id

Citation.title: Citation

CitationFormat.description:
How a citation appears in the text -- citation format evaluation.

5 values replacing the old CitationType enum. Decomposes the format
dimension from the reference system dimension (now in ReferenceSystem).
CitationFormat.title: CitationFormat

CitationStyle.description:
Document-level citation convention -- citation style evaluation.

7 values describing the overall citation style used in a document.
Set at the document level, not per-citation.
CitationStyle.title: CitationStyle

Commentary.description:
A running commentary annotation (philosophical/rabbinic commentary apparatus).

Represents structured commentary that references a specific passage using
a reference system. Supports multi-layer commentary (e.g., Rashi + Tosafot
on the same Talmudic passage, or editor + translator commentary).

passage_ref.description: What passage it comments on (canonical coordinates, e.g., 'Gen 1:1', '264a')
passage_ref.title: Passage Ref

reference_system.description: How it locates the passage (e.g., CATCHWORD, CHAPTER_VERSE)

target_location.description: Optional precise location of the referenced passage in the GT corpus

layer.description: Commentary layer identifier for multi-layer commentary (e.g., 'rashi', 'tosafot')
layer.title: Layer

Commentary.title: Commentary

ContentSpan.description:
A span of content text, potentially spanning multiple pages.

Used for note/commentary content that may continue across page boundaries.
The is_continuation flag marks spans after the first page.
char_offset and char_length support endnote positioning within shared regions.

is_continuation.description: True if this span continues from a previous page
is_continuation.title: Is Continuation

char_offset.description: Character offset within region text (for endnote positioning in shared regions)
char_offset.title: Char Offset

char_length.description: Length of this span within region text (for endnote positioning in shared regions)
char_length.title: Char Length

ContentSpan.title: ContentSpan

CrossReference.description: An internal cross-reference within the document (e.g., 'see section 3').
CrossReference.title: CrossReference

DocumentGT.description:
Document-level ground truth: the companion to page-level PageGT.

Captures cross-page semantic elements, document metadata, structural
hierarchy, layout registers (SFP-1), note schemas, and citation style.
Forward-compatible via extra="allow".

v2.0.0: DocumentRelationships, FootnoteLink, CitationBibLink removed.
Relationships are now embedded in elements (Note.body_marker,
Citation.bib_entry_id, CrossReference.target_section_id).

source.description: Document source metadata and bibliographic info

note_schemas.description: Document-level note numbering conventions (multiple simultaneous schemas supported)
note_schemas.title: Note Schemas

registers.description: SFP-1: named reading streams / column identities
registers.title: Registers

DocumentGT.title: DocumentGT

DocumentSource.description: Document source metadata and bibliographic information.
DocumentSource.title: DocumentSource

DocumentStructure.description: Document structural hierarchy: table of contents and section organization.
DocumentStructure.title: DocumentStructure

FormattingAnnotation.description:
A text formatting/decoration annotation with character-level positioning.

Tracks formatting at character granularity within a page region, enabling
precise reconstruction of bold, italic, small caps, and other decorations.

Supports language tagging (BCP 47), script variant identification (SFP-3),
and color annotation with semantic meaning (SFP-4).

formatting_type.description: Type of text formatting (bold, italic, etc.)

char_offset.description: Character offset of formatting start within region text
char_offset.title: Char Offset

char_length.description: Length of formatted text span in characters
char_length.title: Char Length

text.description: The formatted text span (optional, for convenience)
text.title: Text

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for this span (e.g., 'de', 'el', 'la', 'he')
language.title: Language

script_variant.description: Script variant when BCP 47 script subtag is insufficient (SFP-3, e.g., Rashi vs square Hebrew)

color_value.description: CSS color value when formatting_type is COLOR (e.g., '#FF0000', 'red')
color_value.title: Color Value

FormattingAnnotation.title: FormattingAnnotation

FormattingType.description:
Text formatting/decoration types -- HOW text is decorated.

9 values for inline formatting evaluation. SUBSCRIPT, MONOSPACE,
and COLOR added per SFP-4 for mathematical notation, code samples,
and highlighted/colored text spans.
FormattingType.title: FormattingType

GTProfile.description:
Configuration profile defining active annotation types and validation.

A GTProfile captures which labels from the universal superset are active
for a specific use case. The three default profiles are:
- extraction-eval: Text extraction quality evaluation
- layout-annotation: Visual layout detection (IoU, mAP)
- full-scholarly: Comprehensive scholarly annotation

Profiles are loaded from layered YAML files via the config loader.

v2.0.0: Added citation_formats, reference_systems, note_placements,
script_variants categories. Renamed document_types to document_section_types.
Updated defaults to use note_area/note (not footnote_area/footnote).
GTProfile.title: GTProfile

LayoutRegister.description:
A named reading stream or column in a multi-register document.

Provides first-class identity for parallel text streams, commentary layers,
bilingual columns, and multi-register layouts. Each register describes a
distinct reading stream with its own author, language, text direction,
and typographic conventions.

Examples:
- Talmud page: registers for Mishnah text, Gemara, Rashi commentary, Tosafot
- Bilingual edition: registers for original language and translation
- Critical edition: registers for main text, apparatus criticus, editor notes
- Multi-column layout: registers for left_column, right_column

text_direction.description: Base text direction for this register
text_direction.title: Text Direction

LayoutRegister.title: LayoutRegister

LocationRef.description:
Reference to a specific location in the GT corpus.

Standardizes the scattered page/region_id/char_offset/char_length pattern
used across semantic elements. Use for body_marker, content_marker,
target_location, and any element that references a position in a page region.
LocationRef.title: LocationRef

MarginalReference.description:
A marginal reference system annotation (Stephanus, Bekker, Akademie, custom).

Philosophy texts use standard reference systems in margins: Stephanus pagination
for Plato, Bekker numbers for Aristotle, Akademie edition numbers for Kant.

v2.0.0: Uses shared ReferenceSystem enum instead of the old MarginalRefType,
eliminating duplication between Citation and MarginalReference.

raw_text.description: Reference text as displayed in margin
raw_text.title: Raw Text

reference_system.description: Type of marginal reference system (e.g., Stephanus, Bekker)

MarginalReference.title: MarginalReference

Note.description:
A note (unified model replacing Footnote + Endnote).

Uses LocationRef for precise marker positioning instead of the old MarkerInfo.
Supports multi-page notes via ContentSpan list with is_continuation flags.
Placement distinguishes footnotes (page_bottom) from endnotes (end_of_chapter,
end_of_book) and marginal notes (margin).

body_marker.description: Where reference marker appears in body text

content_marker.description: Where note content begins (important for endnotes where content is distant from marker)

placement.description: Where the note content appears in the document
placement.title: Placement

scope.description: Scope of the numbering reset boundary for this note
scope.title: Scope

note_schema_id.description: Reference to NoteSchema in DocumentGT for numbering convention
note_schema_id.title: Note Schema Id

Note.title: Note

NoteSchema.description:
Document-level note numbering convention.

Describes how notes are numbered/marked throughout a document or section.
Multiple NoteSchemas can coexist (e.g., author footnotes use symbols,
translator footnotes use arabic numerals). Referenced by Note.note_schema_id.

schema_id.description: Unique identifier for this note schema
schema_id.title: Schema Id

marker_type.description: Type of marker used for notes
marker_type.title: Marker Type

symbol_sequence.description: For symbolic markers: sequence of symbols (e.g., ['*', 'dagger', 'double_dagger', 'section', 'parallel', 'pilcrow'])
symbol_sequence.title: Symbol Sequence

reset_boundary.description: Where note numbering resets (e.g., per-page, per-chapter)
reset_boundary.title: Reset Boundary

placement.description: Where note content is placed in the document
placement.title: Placement

note_source.description: Who wrote the notes using this schema
note_source.title: Note Source

NoteSchema.title: NoteSchema

PageDependency.description:
Cross-page relationship metadata.

Captures how this page relates to its neighbors: whether content continues
across page boundaries, and whether note markers or note content are orphaned
(body marker on one page, note content on another -- common with endnotes).

continues_from_previous.description: Some content on this page continues from the prior page
continues_from_previous.title: Continues From Previous

continues_to_next.description: Some content on this page continues to the next page
continues_to_next.title: Continues To Next

unresolved_markers.description: Body markers on this page with no corresponding note on this page (endnote refs)
unresolved_markers.title: Unresolved Markers

orphan_continuations.description: Note content on this page with no corresponding body marker on this page
orphan_continuations.title: Orphan Continuations

PageDependency.title: PageDependency

PageGT.description:
Page-level ground truth containing spatial annotations.

Each page file captures regions (spatial + semantic annotations),
reading order, quality metadata, cross-page dependencies, section
context, and page-level verifications. Forward-compatible via extra="allow".

v2.0.0 additions:
- section_context: hierarchical section path for self-describing pages
- page_dependency: cross-page dependency metadata
- base_direction: default text direction for this page (SFP-2)

section_context.description: Hierarchical section path for self-describing pages
section_context.title: Section Context

base_direction.description: SFP-2: default text direction for this page
base_direction.title: Base Direction

PageGT.title: PageGT

PageNumberAnnotation.description:
A page number annotation capturing the display format and mapping.

Maps between printed page labels (roman, arabic) and PDF page indices.
PageNumberAnnotation.title: PageNumberAnnotation

PageQuality.description:
Page-level quality assessment -- hybrid categorical + numeric model.

Replaces the old ScanQuality and Difficulty enums with a richer model:
- Categorical: overall quality, is_scan flag
- Artifact list: specific quality issues (free-form, documented recommended values)
- Difficulty factors: signals affecting annotation difficulty
- Numeric metrics: optional DPI, contrast, skew, noise, OCR confidence

Recommended artifact values: "bleed_through", "foxing", "skew",
"margin_cropping", "water_damage", "faded_ink", "handwritten_overlay",
"binding_shadow", "staining", "torn_page".

Recommended difficulty_factors values: "dense_footnotes", "multi_column",
"mixed_language", "complex_typography", "poor_scan", "non_latin_script",
"overlapping_regions", "marginal_annotations", "tables_with_text".

overall.description: Quick categorical quality assessment for human annotation
overall.title: Overall

is_scan.description: True if scanned document, False if born-digital
is_scan.title: Is Scan

dpi_estimate.description: Estimated DPI of the page image
dpi_estimate.title: Dpi Estimate

PageQuality.title: PageQuality

ParsedCitation.description: Structured citation data extracted from raw citation text.
ParsedCitation.title: ParsedCitation

ReferenceSystem.description:
What coordinates locate the referenced passage.

13 values shared by Citation and MarginalReference, eliminating
the old MarginalRefType duplication. CATCHWORD added per SFP-6
for pre-modern printed books where page headers serve as navigation
aids rather than standard pagination.
ReferenceSystem.title: ReferenceSystem

Region.description:
A spatial region on a page with optional semantic annotations.

Inherits GTElement's id, verifications, tags, and extra="allow".

Supports cross-page continuation (is_continuation, continues_to_next),
sub-region hierarchy (children), register identity (register_id, SFP-1),
and explicit text direction (text_direction, SFP-2).

bbox.description: Normalized bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1]

semantic_labels.description: Semantic meaning (independent dimension from spatial label)
semantic_labels.title: Semantic Labels

is_continuation.description: True if this region continues content from a previous page
is_continuation.title: Is Continuation

continues_to_next.description: True if this region's content continues to the next page
continues_to_next.title: Continues To Next

semantic_element_ids.description: IDs of DocumentGT semantic elements associated with this region
semantic_element_ids.title: Semantic Element Ids

children.description: Sub-regions (table cells, figures within figures, block quotes within notes)
children.title: Children

register_id.description: LayoutRegister this region belongs to (SFP-1, e.g., 'main_text', 'commentary_rashi')
register_id.title: Register Id

text_direction.description: Base text direction for this region's content (SFP-2)
text_direction.title: Text Direction

Region.title: Region

ScriptVariant.description:
Script variants where BCP 47 script subtag is insufficient (SFP-3).

6 values for script variant detection. Primary use case: Rashi script
vs square Hebrew -- both are "he-Hebr" in BCP 47 but typographically
distinct with different OCR models. Also covers Arabic calligraphic
styles (Nastaliq vs Naskh) and historical European scripts (Fraktur).
CUSTOM allows project-specific script variants beyond the built-in set.
ScriptVariant.title: ScriptVariant

Section.description: A document section/chapter with hierarchical structure.
Section.title: Section

SectionContextEntry.description:
A single entry in the hierarchical section path for a page.

Provides per-page section context so each page is self-describing:
an annotator or evaluation pipeline can determine which section(s)
a page belongs to without loading the full DocumentGT.

section_id.description: Reference to Section element in DocumentGT
section_id.title: Section Id

starts_on_this_page.description: True if this section begins on this page
starts_on_this_page.title: Starts On This Page

ends_on_this_page.description: True if this section ends on this page
ends_on_this_page.title: Ends On This Page

SectionContextEntry.title: SectionContextEntry

SemanticType.description:
Semantic element types -- WHAT it means.

9 values independent from spatial labels. A region can be spatially
'text_block' and semantically 'note'. Used by the semantic element
evaluation task to assess element classification accuracy.
NOTE replaces the old FOOTNOTE + ENDNOTE split; COMMENTARY added
for philosophical/rabbinic running commentary.
SemanticType.title: SemanticType

SousRature.description:
Text written 'under erasure' (sous rature) -- a Derridean philosophical concept.

Represents text that is simultaneously present and crossed out, indicating
a term that is inadequate yet necessary. Common in continental philosophy.

char_length.description: Length of crossed-out text in characters
char_length.title: Char Length

SousRature.title: SousRature

SpatialLabel.description:
Spatial layout region types -- WHERE on the page.

21 values for visual layout detection. Used by the spatial label
evaluation task to assess region classification accuracy.
NOTE_AREA and NOTE_CONTINUATION replace the old FOOTNOTE_AREA,
ENDNOTE_AREA, and FOOTNOTE_CONTINUATION (notes are unified).
SpatialLabel.title: SpatialLabel

ToCEntry.description: A single entry in a table of contents.
ToCEntry.title: ToCEntry

ValidationConfig.description:
Validation requirements for a GT profile.

Controls what is required when validating GT annotations.
Different profiles have different requirements -- e.g., layout-annotation
requires bbox but not text, while extraction-eval requires text.
ValidationConfig.title: ValidationConfig

VerificationRecord.description:
A single verification event for a GT element.

Multiple records per element support inter-annotator agreement.
Confidence is a reviewer property, not an element property -- GT is truth
by definition; confidence reflects how sure the reviewer is.

confidence.description: Reviewer's confidence in the annotation correctness
confidence.title: Confidence

VerificationRecord.title: VerificationRecord
